name: off-late-queued-input-defers-explicit-handoff
description: official-host.ts:1798 'late queued input defers an explicit handoff that no longer fits'. Window 32,000 / reserve 1,000: new_context (20,000-char handoff) is accepted at its original capacity; a sibling tool waits until a steer message (85,000 chars, sent by a trigger once new_context has finished) is pending and returns; the turn boundary rechecks pending input, defers the reset (no boundary; a posthorse-reset-deferred entry) and the queued input is processed. (tool_execution_end is not captured: the two tools' completion order is host timing.)
